llms: # QuotesDone

> QuotesDone is a UAE marketplace where a customer posts a job once and licence-checked suppliers quote on it anonymously. Posting and comparing are free. The customer pays 3% of the one quote they choose, shown before they pay, to see that supplier's name and contact details.

QuotesDone is built for every trade in the UAE except food & beverage, for jobs anywhere in the UAE, Dubai and Abu Dhabi included. Examples: fit-out & interiors, electrical & MEP, flooring, CCTV & security, aluminium & glass, landscaping and signage.
## How it works
1. You describe the job: text, a photo, a drawing or a BOQ. No calls and no site-visit booking.
2. The platform qualifies it: it recognises the trade, asks the questions suppliers need answered and lists the documents and approvals they will be held to.

3. Verified suppliers are invited: only verified suppliers who confirm that trade on their profile, from anywhere in the UAE, capped so the job never becomes a bidding flood. Your identity is removed first.
4. Quotes are checked: a quote without a price, lead time, validity or warranty is held, with notes telling the supplier what is missing. Only a complete quote reaches you.

5. You compare every quote: the top 3 are levelled on price, completeness and delivery into a comparison report you can export as a PDF. Every other quote is listed too, and you can choose any of them.
6. You reveal one, or none: pay 3% of the quote you choose, shown before you pay. Only that supplier learns who you are.
## Who sees what

- Before the reveal, a supplier sees the scope, the quantities, the emirate and any drawing whose identifying details have been covered. You see price, terms, the licence check and track record, with no name.
- After the reveal, only the supplier you chose sees your name and contact details. Other suppliers never see each other's quotes and are never revealed.
## Timing
- Quotes usually arrive within 3-5 working days, and you are notified as each one lands.
- After a reveal the supplier has 5 working days to respond; we chase them after 3. If they stay silent, everything you paid is refunded.
## For suppliers
- Quoting is free and there is no commission: you keep 100% of every job you win. The customer pays the 3% reveal fee.
- Registration is free, permanently, for the first 1,000 suppliers to register. From the 1,001st registration an annual subscription of AED 1,000 applies.
- You are invited only to jobs in the trades and services you confirm on your verified profile, anywhere in the UAE.
## Pages
- [How it works](https://quotesdone.com/how-it-works): the six steps, who sees what, and timing
- [FAQ](https://quotesdone.com/faq): fees, anonymity, refunds and suppliers
- [For suppliers](https://quotesdone.com/supplier): registration and how invitations work
- [Terms](https://quotesdone.com/terms)
